headline: Wardens Recover Lost Post at Callahan's Passage; Stlican Ground Ruined
war_summary: Since our last edition, the Wardens have recovered the Callahan's Passage post that had fallen to no-man's-land; all ten strongpoints there once more fly their colors, though the cost stays terrible — nearly eleven thousand Colonial and twelve thousand Warden losses in a day, with Crumbling Post again the storm centre and fresh engagements logged within the hour. On Stlican Shelf the ledger shifted: one Colonial post now lies in ruin, and the record there was amended mere minutes before press time, Breaker Town and Port of Rime the busiest grounds. The Weathered Expanse stands unchanged at six Colonial posts, one Warden, two in ruin, but the butcher's bill soared — more than eight thousand Colonial and twelve thousand Warden casualties in a day, the hourly rate climbing steeply, even as no post changed hands in the past two hours. Palantine Berm's guns have fallen quiet after the morning's struggle, the Wardens keeping all seven posts. On the Nevish Line no flag has moved since the prior evening, yet losses mount at some four hundred an hour to each side. Day five hundred twenty-three closes with thirty-four victory towns still unclaimed.
